name: mobile-audit-plan
description: Mobile-depth audit of the 2D plan editor at 390x844: plan toolbar touch targets, room-type set, add opening, socket captions + hackability overlay legibility at phone zoom, MEP point placement.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: sockets-legibility
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg=document.querySelector('.plan-screen svg'); const texts=[...(svg?document.querySelectorAll('.plan-screen text'):[])]; const sizes=texts.map(t=>parseFloat(getComputedStyle(t).fontSize)); const min=Math.min(...sizes); const anno=texts.filter(t=>/socket|MEP|\/\d/i.test(t.textContent||'')).length; window.__planTextMin=min; window.__planTextCount=texts.length; })()

steps.name: set-room-type
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const rooms=s.floorPlan?.rooms||[]; const r=rooms[0]; if(r){ s.updateRoom(r.id,{category:'study'}); window.__setRoom=r.name; } return rooms.length })()

steps.name: toggle-hackability
steps.eval: (function(){ const btns=[...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-screen button, .plan-toolbar button, button')]; const b=btns.find(x=>/hackab|structur|demolish/i.test((x.textContent||'')+(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||''))); if(b){ b.click(); window.__hackClicked=(b.textContent||b.getAttribute('aria-label')); } else { window.__hackClicked='NOT-FOUND'; } })()

steps.name: add-socket
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const rooms=s.floorPlan?.rooms||[]; const r=rooms[0]; if(r){ const cx=(r.outline||[]).reduce((a,p)=>a+p.x,0)/(r.outline?.length||1); const cz=(r.outline||[]).reduce((a,p)=>a+p.z,0)/(r.outline?.length||1); s.addElectricalPoint({x:cx||2,z:cz||2,kind:'socket-double'}); } })()
